summary: See what is new in every version, get security updates within the hour, and each mail goes out once.

new.title: What's new in the web app
new.text: Help > What's new shows what each version brought, newest first, in plain words. A New mark appears after an update until you open the page.

new.title: Security updates install within the hour
new.text: When a security update of the images SecurityInsight runs on is released, your install takes it within the hour, without waiting for the nightly update. A running job is never stopped for it.

fixes.title: Each mail is sent only once
fixes.text: The Risk Analysis mail and the daily summary mail are no longer sent twice when a step runs again. Other queued mails also go out only once.

fixes.title: Data correlation waits for new fields
fixes.text: When a data table is still taking a new field, correlation now waits for it instead of stopping the run. The steps after it then run as usual.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: When two collections run at once, the newer device and identity details are kept. Old records about how complete each collection was are removed with the collection.
